issue: Screening creatinine was 198.4 umol/L (1.6x ULN), which exceeds the range named in exclusion EXCL27; a retest 8 days later was 88.4 umol/L, and the record does not show which value was used to confirm eligibility.
query_text: At Screening 1 (2013-02-12), creatinine was 198.4 umol/L (reference 62–124 umol/L). Exclusion criterion EXCL27 excludes patients whose creatinine is above the reference range. At the unscheduled visit on 2013-02-20 the result was 88.4 umol/L, before first dose on 2013-02-27. Please confirm whether the screening value of 198.4 umol/L is correct as entered or is a transcription or sample error. Please also confirm that eligibility under EXCL27 was assessed on the repeat result, with any sponsor approval documented.

issue: Pruritus, rash and erythema are each recorded twice with the same dates, severity and relationship but different outcomes; three records say NOT RECOVERED/NOT RESOLVED even though they have an end date of 2013-07-07.
query_text: The AE form has two entries for each of these events, with the same start and end dates: PRURITUS (start 2013-05-14, AE 2 and AE 5), RASH (start 2013-06-18, AE 3 and AE 6) and ERYTHEMA (start 2013-06-18, AE 4 and AE 7). All of them have end date 2013-07-07. AE 2, 3 and 4 are recorded as "NOT RECOVERED/NOT RESOLVED" and AE 5, 6 and 7 as "RECOVERED/RESOLVED". Please confirm whether these are duplicate entries or separate episodes. If they are duplicates, please remove the extra records. If they are separate episodes, please correct the dates. Please also make sure the outcome agrees with the end date: an event with an end date would not normally be "not recovered".

issue: The patient discontinued for ADVERSE EVENT on 2013-07-16, but no AE record has action taken filled in, so the record does not show which event led to discontinuation.
query_text: The Disposition form gives "ADVERSE EVENT" as the reason for discontinuation on 2013-07-16 (Week 20), and the last dose was on 2013-07-06. On the AE form, "action taken" is blank for every event, including pruritus (from 2013-05-14) and rash and erythema (from 2013-06-18), which all ended on 2013-07-07. Please identify which adverse event(s) led to discontinuation and update "action taken" on that AE record (for example, study drug withdrawn). If the event that led to discontinuation is not yet recorded, please add it.

issue: Sodium was below the reference range at screening and at 7 of 8 later visits (low of 129 mmol/L), but hyponatremia is not recorded in medical history or as an adverse event.
query_text: Serum sodium was below the reference range (135–145 mmol/L) at screening (132 mmol/L on 2013-02-12), at the unscheduled visit (130 mmol/L on 2013-02-20) and at Weeks 2, 4, 6, 12, 16 and 20 (lowest 129 mmol/L on 2013-03-13 and 2013-04-10). Hyponatremia is not recorded in medical history or on the AE form. Please assess whether these values are clinically significant. If they are a pre-existing condition, please consider adding it to medical history. If any value represents a clinically significant worsening, please consider recording it as an adverse event.
